result.markdown: --- title: "Week 8: ARIMA models" --- ::: {.cell} ::: ## What you will learn this week * AR, MA, ARMA and ARIMA models * Selecting model orders manually and automatically ## Pre-class activities Read [Sections 9.3-9.8 of the textbook](https://otexts.com/fpp3/arima.html) and watch all embedded videos ## Tutorial exercises ::: {.callout-note} ## Tutorial Learning Objectives 1. **Fit and compare ARIMA forecasting models**. - Able to use ARIMA() (with transformations where needed) to select an appropriate model, generate forecasts, and compare them against alternative specified ARIMA structures. 2. **Evaluate model adequacy using residual diagnostics**. - Check whether ARIMA model residuals resemble white noise (including examining autocorrelation in residuals) and use this evidence to refine or justify model choice. 3. **Translate between model equations and ARIMA notation**. - Recognise ARIMA model equations in algebraic form and correctly express them using ARIMA $(p,d,q)$ notation. ::: - Complete Exercises 7, 8, 15 (a to c), 16 (a to c) from [Section 9.11 of the book](https://otexts.com/fpp3/arima-exercises.html). ## Assignments * [GA3](../assignments/G3.qmd) is due on Tuesday 05 May. * [IA4](../assignments/A4.qmd) is due on Friday 15 May. ## Weekly quiz * Week 8 quiz: [ETF3231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5400154) | [ETF5231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5402237) — Due Wednesday 29 April.
